title: Bumper Harvest
poster: A carrier from the east road
text: A road crew is passing through and wants a great deal of one crop.

title: Fine Vegetables
poster: A buyer from the far market
text: A buyer wants vegetables of gold quality, sent through the shipping bin.

title: Too Many Fish
poster: A cook from the coast road
text: A kitchen on the coast road has run out of one kind of fish and wants a great many of it.

title: Still Waters
poster: A fish buyer from the far market
text: A buyer wants a catch from one kind of water, and a good deal of it.

title: Cave Patrol
poster: A carrier at the mine hall
text: The carriers want one kind of cave creature thinned out before the next haul.
